Players Committee card image of [[L3-37 (Elthree-Threeseven)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “While aboard (or stacked on) a freighter, adds 1 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed, and when forfeiting L3-37, stack her on that freighter. May lose L3-37 to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt targeting a freighter she is aboard or stacked on.” Uploaded unchanged.
